title: Fit an epistatic sequence-activity model and propose a double mutant
data_provenance: SIMULATED. The variant activities in examples/enzyme-engineering/data/ come from a seeded generator (seed 20260726). No protein, assay, or published deep mutational scan is behind these values, and no design proposed here is a real experimental lead.
prompt:
Work in the examples/enzyme-engineering project. The data gives measured log2 activities for single and double mutants of a simulated enzyme. Fit an additive (per-mutation) model and an epistatic model that adds pairwise interaction terms, both ridge-regularized, and compare them by cross-validated R2. Hold out a set of double mutants the model never saw and report the held-out Pearson correlation and RMSE on them, because the in-sample fit of an interaction model proves very little. Compare the fitted additive effects against data/simulation_truth.csv, count how many of your top ten designs appear in the truth's top ten, and propose the best double mutant your model predicts.

Produce results/results.json with every number your code computed, results/designs.csv with the ranked designs, figures/model_and_designs.png, and report.md. In the report, keep each headline number on the same line as the label naming it, cite by path the files the numbers came from, and state plainly that the data is simulated and the proposed design is not an experimental result.

rubric.notes: `truth_tolerance` values are set against examples/enzyme-engineering/baseline/results.json. Cross-validated R2 and the held-out correlation get room for a different regularization path or fold split; n_variants and n_mutations are facts about the input and are exact.

criteria.description: results/results.json exists, is non-empty, and parses as a JSON object
results/designs.csv parses and pairs each design with a prediction
figures/model_and_designs.png is a real, non-truncated PNG
report.md exists and is readable text
the machine-readable results record that the input data is simulated
all 451 measured variants were used (a fact about the input, so exact)
all 20 mutated positions are in the model (exact)
the epistatic model reaches a cross-validated R2 near the reference 0.892
epistasis buys a real gain in cross-validated R2 over the additive model
held-out doubles correlate with the prediction near the reference 0.939
the cross-validated R2 in the prose is the one the run produced
criteria.label: cross-validated R2 of the epistatic model

criteria.description: the held-out correlation in the prose is the one the run produced
criteria.label: held-out Pearson correlation

criteria.description: the top-ten overlap with the answer key in the prose is the one the run produced
criteria.label: top-ten overlap with the answer key

criteria.description: the predicted activity of the proposed design in the prose is the one the run produced
criteria.label: predicted log2 activity of the best design

the report states that the data is simulated
